name: Neko Masshigura ~Nekomimi Café ni Youkoso~
original_name: ねこまっしぐら ～ねこみみカフェにようこそ～
source:
This is the debut title for KonekoSoft, sister company of NekonekoSoft. During summer vacation, the protagonist moved to another town to work at a live-in part-time job at the cat café Masshigura. However, he found out when he arrived that there weren’t any cats there, but rather catgirls! And it’s not a cosplay… the cat ears and tails are real! He thought to himself that this must be paradise.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/07/05/july-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是KonekoSoft（NekonekoSoft的姐妹公司）的处女作。暑假期间，主人公搬到另一个城镇，在猫咖Masshigura做一份提供住宿的兼职。然而，他抵达后才发现那里没有猫，只有猫娘！而且这可不是角色扮演……那些猫耳和猫尾巴都是真的！他心想，这一定是天堂。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/07/05/july-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
